  • Change or cancel an order line

    • Change or cancel a sales order line after it is entered.

      1. change or cancel the line on the sales order; once it is released, the warehouse decides whether that is still allowed
      2. if the change is allowed, the outbound line follows it, and its advice and picking list are deleted
      3. if cancelling is no longer allowed, finish the shipment with a shipped quantity of 0 and return the goods to stock with a transfer order
      4. a line that already has a shipment cancels only after Allow Changes to Shipment is cleared on that shipment
      5. cancelling a line that is already advised asks whether its advice is deleted; on yes the line ends as Shipped with a shipped quantity of 0
      6. Not documented for this release.
  • Change a line's date or quantity

    • Move a sales order line's delivery date, or change its quantity, once the line is split into delivery lines.

      1. with no delivery lines linked, change the planned delivery date or the ordered quantity on the order line
      2. with delivery lines linked, the date on the order line is disabled; change it on the delivery lines, or on the order header, which removes the delivery lines after a warning
      3. changing the ordered quantity on the order line removes every linked delivery line; once one of them is delivered, change the quantity on the delivery line instead
      4. where the CTP check for sales is on, LN refuses a new date the item is not available on
      5. Not documented for this release.
  • Rush an order

    • Give a sales order, or one line of it, the highest priority through the warehouse.

      1. choose Rush Order on the sales order, or Rush Order Line on one line; the order's priority becomes 1
      2. release it to warehousing, where its outbound lines are advised and processed before any others
      3. Not documented for this release.
  • Direct delivery

    • Have the supplier deliver straight to the customer, so that Warehousing is not involved.

      1. set the line's delivery type to Direct Delivery, by hand or from the shortage menu that appears when stock is short
      2. generate the purchase order for the line, from a purchase order advice or directly
      3. record the supplier's receipt in Procurement and send the delivery back to the sales order
      4. Not documented for this release.
  • Cross-docking

    • Fill a sales order that has no stock by taking inbound goods straight from receipt to the staging location.

      1. set the line's delivery type to Cross-docking, by hand or from the shortage menu that appears when stock is short
      2. generate the purchase order for the line, from a purchase order advice or directly
      3. release the purchase order and the sales order to warehousing
      4. Not documented for this release.
  • Blocked release

    • Stop a sales order line from releasing.

      1. read why it is blocked: an order over the credit limit, overdue invoices, a margin exceeded, a failed export or letter-of-credit check, or a reason someone set by hand
      2. release it in Blocked Sales Order (Lines) tdsls4520m000, a session in neither menu extract
      3. a user can release only the kinds of hold their profile allows, set in User Profiles tdsls0139m000, Sales➔Master Data➔General➔User Profiles
      4. Not documented for this release.
  • Sales returns

    • Take goods back from a customer.

      1. set up a return order type in Order Types tdsls0594m000, Sales➔Master Data➔Orders➔Order Types, as Return Inventory or Return Rejects, with a warehousing order type that receives
      2. create a sales order of that type, and give it the original document and a return reason
      3. copy the lines from the original document; they arrive with a negative quantity and amount
      4. approve the order and release it to warehousing, which receives the goods
      5. release it to invoicing, then process it
      6. Not documented for this release.

  • Generate Master Planning

    • Work out a supply plan per period for the items planned by a master plan.

      1. run it for a range of plan items; a supply plan is made only inside each item's master-planning horizon
      2. production and purchase count as sources only where the item's Production Plan or Purchase Plan is set to Generate or Always Update
      3. Not documented for this release.
  • Exception Messages by Planner

    • List what planning says about the orders that already exist.

      1. planning compares the receipts that exist with what is needed, and raises a message where they differ
      2. a reschedule message asks for a receipt earlier or later, and a cancel message marks a receipt nothing needs
      3. a tolerance in days, set per message type, keeps small shifts quiet
      4. Not documented for this release.
  • Confirm Order Planning

    • Confirm planned orders before they are transferred.

      1. confirm the planned orders, then transfer them

  • Report Operations

    • Issue the material and report the work done.

      1. issue the material
      2. report the operations and the order completed
  • Report a serialized item completed

    • Report a serialized end item completed, so that the right serial number is the one booked.

      1. find out who sets the serial status: As-Built Status Handling in Production Order Parameters is Automatic or Manual
      2. Automatic, one item: on the last operation enter the quantity completed and its serial number, then save
      3. Automatic, several items: enter the quantity alone; LN takes that many serials still at Created, in the order they are listed
      4. Manual: from the operation open Serial Numbers, and set each finished serial from Created to Assigned
      5. Manual: back on the operation click Default Qty Completed, which fills in the number set to Assigned, then save
      6. Not documented for this release.

  • Backflush Materials and Hours

    • Let LN issue the material by itself, as the work is reported.

      1. a backflushed material is issued when a quantity of the end product is reported completed or rejected
      2. only the materials linked to the operations reported are issued; on an order with no operations, all of them are
      3. Not documented for this release.

  • Cancel Shipments

    • Cancel a shipment before it leaves, as when the truck did not come or the customer changed the order.

      1. check it can be cancelled: not confirmed, and no not-shipped quantity on it; a frozen shipment is reopened first
      2. select the shipment, one of its lines or its load, and choose Cancel on the Actions menu
      3. in the dialog, choose whether the goods go back to stock and whether the order line is finalized, then continue
      4. a finalized order line reads Shipped, so shipping it later needs a new order line; left open, the same line gets a new shipment
      5. Not documented for this release.
  • Warehouse transfer

    • Move stock from one warehouse to another.

      1. create the transfer order
      2. advise, pick and ship it
      3. receive it at the destination
  • Cycle Counting Orders

    Not documented yet.

  • Adjustment Orders

    • Adjust stock with an adjustment order.

      1. for a serialized item, open the line's stock point details, where its serial numbers are kept
      2. counted more than LN holds: add the serial numbers
      3. counted fewer: leave the adjusted quantity at 0 and enter a negative variance for each missing serial
      4. Not documented for this release.
  • Inventory Blocking by Zone/Location

    • Put stock on hold, for a whole zone or location, or for one lot or stock point.

      1. block a zone or a location here; a lot and a single stock point each have their own session beside it on the menu
      2. choose the reason: one kind tells planning to go on counting the stock, for a short check, and the other tells planning the stock is gone
      3. a block on stock raises the item's inventory on hold; blocking only a kind of transaction does not
      4. Not documented for this release.
  • Quarantine Inventory

    Not documented yet.

  • Handling Units

    • Keep stock in handling units, the labelled packages LN tracks as one thing.

      1. LN can make them by itself: at the pick, where the stock had none, and from a shipment notice where the warehouse or item says so
      2. a handling unit is received only while it is Open, or In Transit on a transfer, and advised only once it is Received or Approved
      3. its lot and serial numbers must match its order line, or confirming fails
      4. most statuses can be worked on; a unit that is Quarantine, Frozen, Shipped or In Transit cannot
      5. Not documented for this release.

  • Generate Orders (Kanban)

    Not documented yet.

  • Assembly Orders

    • Pick a kit's components and put them together into one item that stays in the warehouse.

      1. create the assembly order by hand for the item to be assembled; its components come from the item's list of components
      2. LN makes an outbound line for each component and one inbound line for the assembled item
      3. receive the inbound line to say the assembly is done, and put the item away like any receipt
      4. the order cannot be changed once a component line is past Open, or deleted while it has component lines
      5. Not documented for this release.
  • Print Replenishment List

    • Refill pick locations from bulk locations.

      1. give the item a fixed pick location, with a minimum inventory and a minimum replenishment quantity; only fixed pick locations are refilled
      2. link bulk locations to pick locations in the replenishment matrix
      3. run this session to start the refill; it can create the transfer orders and process them
      4. Not documented for this release.
  • Warehouses

    • Define a warehouse, and turn locations on in one that already holds stock.

      1. before turning locations on, clear what is in flight: unconfirmed receipts and shipment lines, inspections, outbound advice and counting orders
      2. block the warehouse for inbound and for outbound
      3. run Change Location System for the warehouse, then give each stock its location in Assign Locations
      4. set up at least one receiving location and one staging location, which a warehouse with locations must have
      5. Not documented for this release.
